basic_details.post_name: Commerce, Social Work (M.S.W), Sugar Technology and 1 more

how_to_apply: Download application form from the official website https://mandyajiversity.karnataka.gov.in/en.
Fill out the application in two sets.
Attach self-attested copies of testimonials, certificates, category certificates, marks cards, and detailed bio-data.
Pay the prescribed application fee via Demand Draft (DD) in favor of Finance Officer, Mandya University, Mandya.
Submit the application to the Registrar, Mandya University before the last date.
Make sure it reaches by 27 October 2026.
important_instructions: Application must be submitted in two sets with all relevant attested documents

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Mandya University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Mandya University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Commerce, 1 Social Work (M.S.W), 1 Sugar Technology, 1 Polymer Science.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for Mandya University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Mandya University website) and send it to Office of the Registrar, Mandya University, Vishwa Gangothri Campus, M.C Road, Mandya - 571401, by by post or in person, to reach by 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General: Rs. 500. SC/ST/Cat-1: Rs. 250.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 16,000 to Rs. 28,000 per month for Commerce, Rs. 16,000 to Rs. 28,000 per month for Social Work (M.S.W), Rs. 16,000 to Rs. 28,000 per month for Sugar Technology, Rs. 16,000 to Rs. 28,000 per month for Polymer Science.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Post Graduate degree with NET/SLET/KSET/Ph.D. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. No claim for regularization of services.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates doing full time job or degree.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Scrutiny of applications. Walk-in interview. Walk-in interview based on academic qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Temporary appointment for the academic year 2026-27.
